description: This file declares functions and constants related to hibernation processing, including process management functions such as HibernateProcess and WakeupProcess, along with error code definitions.

methods.name: HibernateProcess
methods.description: Initiates a hibernation process with specified timeout, process ID, and data directories.

methods.name: WakeupProcess
methods.description: Wakes up a process from hibernation with specified timeout, process ID, and data directories.
